name: applied
description: Job search tracker that reads your Gmail inbox, sorts every message into the right application, and sends anything it is unsure about to a review queue instead of guessing. Next.js 16 and FastAPI on Supabase Postgres with row level security. Try the demo without an account.

paragraphs: Applied turns a job-search inbox into a pipeline. Connect your mail and every confirmation, rejection, interview invite and take-home lands on the application it belongs to — instead of in a spreadsheet that is wrong within a week.
Live app · Status & access · Try it, no account · Privacy · System Card · What you can check · Licensing

The reason to trust a product that reads your mail is not a promise; it is something you can open. Applied publishes specific numbers about itself and scripts/readmefacts.py recomputes every registered one of them from the code that defines it — an unregistered number, or a registered one whose site nobody pointed at the file holding it, is unchecked — readme-facts.yml fails the build when a claim on this page stops matching the source, and a claim reworded so the checker can no longer find it fails too. Where each number terminates is in Verify it.
